lines.en: label dormwarssix8:
scene teacherwar1
Well, that was weird.
lines.zh: 好吧，那挺诡异的。

lines.en: Time to completely ignore it and become a student for the sake of sport.
lines.zh: 是时候彻底无视它，为了比赛而当回学生了。

lines.en: scene teacherwar2
: So it was only for a few seconds? And she went right back to acting normal?
lines.zh: : 所以只持续了几秒钟？然后她就又恢复正常了？

lines.en: : Yeah. It was like some kind of...eggy switch flipped inside of her all of a sudden. And no, I already ruled out drugs.
lines.zh: : 是啊。就好像她体内某个……蛋蛋的开关突然被拨了一下。还有，不用问，我已经排除药物的可能了。

lines.en: : Bitch, of course Ayane ain’t doing drugs. Sounds like some kind of PTSD thing. Just don’t bring up eggs around her at all anymore and see how things go.
lines.zh: : 少扯，Ayane 当然没嗑药。听着像是某种创伤后应激障碍。以后在她面前别提鸡蛋了，看看情况怎么发展。

lines.en: : Like...all of them?
lines.zh: : 比如……所有种类的？

lines.en: : Are eggs a frequent conversation topic of yours?
lines.zh: : 鸡蛋是你经常聊的话题吗？

lines.en: : Maybe at diners.
lines.zh: : 在餐馆里也许吧。

lines.en: : And do you plan on going to a diner with Amamiya?
lines.zh: : 那你打算跟 Amamiya 去餐馆？

lines.en: : If she asks, maybe.
lines.zh: : 如果她开口的话，也许。

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}咳咳。{/i}

lines.en: scene teacherwar3
: What do you want? You’re supposed to raise your hand if you have something to say.
lines.zh: : 你想干什么？有事要说话得先举手。

lines.en: : I’m just trying to subtly recall the last five minutes so I can figure out how I got here.
lines.zh: : 我只是在不露痕迹地回忆过去五分钟，好搞清楚自己是怎么到这儿来的。

lines.en: : Just so we’re all on the same page, I haven’t ruled out drugs for Akira yet.
lines.zh: : 先统一一下认识：我还没排除 Akira 嗑药的可能。

lines.en: : We should give him some. They might fix him.
lines.zh: : 我们应该给他来点。说不定能把他修好。

lines.en: : Only your love can fix me, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 只有你的爱能修好我，Wakana。

lines.en: : Somebody gonna tell Niki that? We’ll probably have a good shot later tonight when she forcibly inserts herself into our circle again.
lines.zh: : 有人去告诉 Niki 吗？今晚晚点她大概又会硬挤进我们的圈子，那是个好机会。

lines.en: : Aren’t you the one who invited her?
lines.zh: : 请她来的不就是你吗？

lines.en: scene teacherwar4
: Yes, but there’s a perfectly good explanation for that. I thought it’d make her like you less.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可这有个非常合理的解释。我以为那样她就不会那么喜欢你了。

lines.en: : I can promise you there is nothing you can do to make her like me less. Trust me, I have tried.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，没有任何办法能让她更不喜欢我。相信我，我试过了。

lines.en: : Where is she, by the way? The only chance I ever got to speak with her was during the beach trip where the two of you cuckolded Imani.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，她在哪儿？我唯一一次有机会跟她说话，是在海边旅行的时候，那次你俩给 Imani 戴了绿帽。

lines.en: scene teacherwar5
: They did not {i}cuckold{/i} me, Wakana! Senpai and I weren’t even a thing yet!
lines.zh: : 他们才没有给我{i}戴绿帽{/i}，Wakana！我和 Senpai 当时还没在一起呢！

lines.en: : He and I definitely cuckolded you, though. It still counts if the cuck is asleep, right?
lines.zh: : 不过他和我确实给你戴了绿帽。被戴绿帽本人睡着也算数吧？

lines.en: scene teacherwar6
: Okay, {i}that{/i} time definitely counts! And thank you for reminding me, Rika! I needed that!
lines.zh: : 好吧，{i}那{/i}次绝对算！谢谢你提醒我，Rika！我正需要这个！

lines.en: : Hey, I’m just saying, if it’s happened two times now, maybe you’re just into it?
lines.zh: : 嘿，我只是说，既然已经发生了两次，也许你其实就是好这口？

lines.en: : Just because a shitty thing keeps happening to me doesn’t mean that I-
lines.zh: : 一件破事老发生在我身上，不代表我就——

lines.en: scene teacherwar7
: Um...I’m sorry for interrupting, but...I think you may have forgotten about us?
lines.zh: : 呃……抱歉打断一下，不过……我觉得你们可能把我们忘了？

lines.en: : Thank you for raising your hand, Fukuyama. And yes, we certainly did.
lines.zh: : 谢谢举手，Fukuyama。是的，我们确实忘了。

lines.en: : I didn’t forget, Futaba. I just have no reason to hide anything from you since I love you so much and I know that you love me too and will acknowledge the romantic pickle I am in right now.
lines.zh: : 我没忘，Futaba。我只是没什么要瞒你的——我那么爱你，也知道你同样爱我，而且你会体谅我现在身陷的这种恋爱窘境。

lines.en: : Bitch, you locked yourself in the damn jar. It ain’t just one pickle anymore, it’s a whole sea of them.
lines.zh: : 少来，你是把自己锁进那个该死的罐子里的。现在可不是一根腌黄瓜了，是整整一片海。

lines.en: : Hey, that’s probably more action than Wakana’s gotten in months.
lines.zh: : 嘿，这动静大概比 Wakana 几个月来的都多。

lines.en: : As the one rational adult here, I suppose I’ll take the lead and remind the two of you {i}less{/i} rational ones that these matters should be reserved for {i}outside{/i} of school.
lines.zh: : 作为这里唯一理性的成年人，我想我该带头提醒你们这两个{i}不太{/i}理性的：这些事应该留到{i}校外{/i}再说。

lines.en: : You tell them, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 说得好，Wakana。

lines.en: : Arakawa, please die in a fire so I no longer have to remember you are here.
lines.zh: : Arakawa，求你被火烧死吧，这样我就不用记得你还在这儿了。

lines.en: : Is it just me, or is this competition shaping up to be yet another nonsensical bout of unwanted chaos and future regret?
lines.zh: : 是我一个人的感觉吗，这场比赛又要变成又一出莫名其妙的混乱和未来的悔恨？

lines.en: : It would be helpful to at least...know what we’re doing exactly.
lines.zh: : 至少……知道我们具体要做什么会有帮助。

lines.en: : Well said. It appears that you and I are the most mature women in the room.
lines.zh: : 说得好。看来你我是这个房间里最成熟的两位女性。

lines.en: scene teacherwar8
: I mean, if we’re going off of physical traits...
lines.zh: : 我是说，如果按身体特征来算的话……

lines.en: : Y’all gotta be cheatin’ the system looking like that. Girls were way smaller back in the day. They putting something in the water now?
lines.zh: : 你们长成这样肯定是作弊了。以前的姑娘可小得多。现在水里是不是加了什么？

lines.en: : The “day” for you was rather recent, wasn’t it? You’ve only been out of college a handful of years.
lines.zh: : 你说的「以前」对你来说挺近的吧？你才大学毕业几年而已。

lines.en: : Those years’ll hit you like a truck if you let them, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 你要是让那几年追上你，它们会像卡车一样撞过来，Wakana。

lines.en: : Have you tried maybe...not letting them?
lines.zh: : 你有没有试过……不让它们追上？

lines.en: : So, should Futaba and I just make up our own rules or do the three of you intend to actually tell them to us?
lines.zh: : 那么，是我和 Futaba 自己定规则，还是你们三位打算真的把规则告诉我们？

lines.en: scene teacherwar9
: I will say that it is kind of weird how urgently you were texting me if we were just going to stand around like we’re at the bar again.
lines.zh: : 我得说，如果我们只是又要像在酒吧那样干站着，你刚才那么急地给我发短信就有点奇怪了。

lines.en: : The rules are pretty straightforward, Touka. Us four adults are going to travel back in time for thirty minutes or so in an effort to recapture our youth.
lines.zh: : 规则很简单，Touka。我们四个成年人要穿越回过去大概三十分钟，试图重拾青春。

lines.en: : You don’t want me recapturing my youth in front of the students. I’d need to take Akira under the bleachers and who {i}knows{/i} when he’d ever get back.
lines.zh: : 你可不会想让我在学生面前重拾青春。那我得把 Akira 拖到看台底下，而他什么时候能回来{i}谁知道{/i}。

lines.en: : Okaaaaay...then let’s just say the four of us will go sit at our desks and put our respective educations in the hands of you guys.
lines.zh: : 好——吧……那就这么说：我们四个坐回自己的课桌，把自己的教育大权交到你们手上。

lines.en: scene teacherwar10
: Is there a specific subject or anything that we’re expected to teach? Or is it just...some sort of free-for-all?
lines.zh: : 有什么特定的科目或者别的要我们教吗？还是说就是……某种自由混战？

lines.en: : The topic can be anything you like as we believe it’s best for the two of you to express your abilities in the fields that you’re most comfortable.
lines.zh: : 主题随你们喜欢，因为我们认为最好让你们在自己最得心应手的领域里展现能力。

lines.en: : We {i}will{/i} be asking questions, though. So don’t get thrown off by any of them if they have nothing to do with what you were talking about!
lines.zh: : 不过我们{i}会{/i}提问。所以如果问题跟你们讲的内容毫无关系，也别被打乱阵脚！

lines.en: : You’re still high from the trivia thing, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你还沉迷在刚才那个冷知识比赛里没出来，对吧？

lines.en: scene teacherwar11
: {i}Ding dong.{/i} Oh, look. It’s the bell. Which means class is now in session and anyone not seated in the next thirty seconds is being expelled.
lines.zh: {i}叮咚。{/i}哦，瞧。铃响了。也就是说现在开始上课，三十秒内没坐好的人一律开除。

lines.en: scene teacherwar12
: You don’t have to tell me twice. Sitting down is probably my favorite hobby right after things like sleeping or talking myself off of a ledge.
lines.zh: : 不用你说第二遍。坐着大概是我最喜欢的爱好，仅次于睡觉和劝自己别跳楼之类的事。

lines.en: : When the hell did you have time to make that? That tea wasn’t there a second ago.
lines.zh: : 你到底是什么时候泡的茶？刚才那儿还没有茶呢。

lines.en: : Akira, hi! Looks like we’re seat-mates! You don’t mind if I scooch a little closer, do you? I forgot my textbook and I need to share.
lines.zh: : Akira，你好！看来我们是同桌！我往你那边挪近一点你不介意吧？我忘带课本了，得跟你合看。

lines.en: : But we don’t even know if there {i}is{/i} a textbook yet.
lines.zh: : 可我们还不知道到底{i}有没有{/i}课本呢。

lines.en: : Pleeeeeease? I get really lonely if-
lines.zh: : 求求你了吗？我一个人会特别孤单的——

lines.en: : Rika Rokuhara.
lines.zh: : Rika Rokuhara。

lines.en: scene teacherwar13
: Here!
: Oh, right. I guess we {i}should{/i} take attendance. Umm...
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我想我们{i}应该{/i}点个名。呃……

lines.en: : A...Akira Arakawa?...
lines.zh: : A……Akira Arakawa？……

lines.en: : Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: : Akira Arakawa?
lines.zh: : Akira Arakawa？

lines.en: : Still here.
lines.zh: : 还在这儿。

lines.en: : Touka?
lines.zh: : Touka？

lines.en: : Presen- oh. Reflex. And sorry for the repetition. I just wanted to try saying his name in this context too. But seeing as we have now both had our fun, this leaves...Wakana Watabe?
lines.zh: : 到——哦。条件反射。抱歉重复了。我也想在这种场合试着喊一次他的名字。不过既然我们俩都玩够了，剩下的就是……Wakana Watabe？

lines.en: : Present.
: And..Imani Imai?
lines.zh: : 还有……Imani Imai？

lines.en: : Also present! And might I say, the two of you are looking absolutely {i}stunning{/i} today.
lines.zh: : 也到！容我说一句，你们俩今天看起来{i}美极了{/i}。

lines.en: : Flattery will get you nowhere, Imai-san. Only the most insidious teacher alive would feed into or allow such open depravity.
lines.zh: : 奉承对你没好处，Imai 女士。只有世上最阴险的教师才会纵容这种公开的堕落。

lines.en: scene teacherwar14
: Despicable. I can’t believe I left my class in the hands of this woman.
lines.zh: : 卑劣。我真不敢相信我把自己的班交给了这个女人。

lines.en: : That wasn’t a pick-up line! I was just-
lines.zh: : 那不是搭讪！我只是——

lines.en: : Fukuyama-sensei, what do you think about divvying up the class and handling two students each? Studies show that the more time a teacher spends with their students, the more likely they are to succeed.
lines.zh: : Fukuyama 老师，你觉得把班分成两半、一人带两个学生怎么样？研究表明，老师和学生待在一起的时间越多，学生就越可能成功。

lines.en: : Ahh, so {i}that’s{/i} why 1-A has been the highest scoring class since before Imani even showed up.
lines.zh: : 啊，{i}原来{/i}这就是 1-A 班在 Imani 来之前就一直成绩最好的原因。

lines.en: : All I’ve ever wanted to do is help this nation’s youth.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子唯一想做的就是帮助这个国家的年轻人。

lines.en: : Uhh...splitting them up is fine. I’ll take Miss Imai and Miss Watabe. And-
lines.zh: : 呃……分开没问题。我带 Imai 老师和 Watabe 老师。然后——

lines.en: : And leave me with the two delinquents? Is this an admission that you’re {i}scared{/i} of instructing them and believe you’d fare better pawning them off on me instead?
lines.zh: : 把那两个不良少年留给我？这是不是等于承认你{i}害怕{/i}教他们，觉得把他们推给我会更好？

lines.en: : It...wasn’t on purpose. But I imagine it...might have been subconscious?
lines.zh: : 那……不是故意的。不过我想……也许是下意识的？

lines.en: : I haven’t even done anything yet and I’m already a delinquent. I wonder if this is how Yumi feels?
lines.zh: : 我什么都还没做就已经是不良少年了。我在想 Yumi 是不是也是这种感觉？

lines.en: : Yumi beat a girl half to death in the middle of a school day.
lines.zh: : Yumi 可是把人打到半死，就在上课时间。

lines.en: : Yes, but it was Nagasawa so she probably had it coming.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可那是 Nagasawa，所以她大概是自找的。

lines.en: scene teacherwar15
: It’s been ages since I last heard her utter my name. Coming here is already worth it.
lines.zh: : 我已经很久没听到她念我的名字了。光是来这一趟就值了。

lines.en: : I only remember because of the restraining order that’s been sitting on my desk for months that I’ve been too busy to file.
lines.zh: : 我记得只是因为那份限制令——它在我桌上放了几个月，我一直太忙没去申请。

lines.en: : Futabaaaaa! Teach them stuuuuuuuuff!
lines.zh: : Futabaaaaaa！教她们点东——西——！

lines.en: : Excuse me, but if the two of you are not members of this class, I’ll have to ask you to leave now.
lines.zh: : 不好意思，如果你们两位不是这个班的学生，我现在就得请你们出去。

lines.en: scene teacherwar16
: We got prior approval, actually. But I believe there was a “no cheering” section on the application, so I’m going to go ahead and get right back to shutting up now.
lines.zh: : 其实我们事先获批了。不过我记得申请表上有「禁止助威」这一条，那我现在就立刻重新闭嘴。

lines.en: : Wow! Does everybody else see that super cute girl off to the side of the room?
lines.zh: : 哇！大家都看到房间边上那个超可爱的女生了吗？

lines.en: : Everyone but Akira. He should just look outside of the window or something.
lines.zh: : 除了 Akira，其他人都看到了。他干脆看看窗外什么的吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, so take this and multiply it by a bunch and that’s basically what I experience every single day.
lines.zh: : 是啊，把这个乘以好几倍，基本上就是我每天的经历。

lines.en: scene teacherwar17
: I can only imagine...I never assumed this would be easy, though. And...maybe I should have prepared more, but I’m not really sure what I can teach you that you don’t already know.
lines.zh: : 我能想象……不过我从没以为这会容易。而且……也许我该多准备准备，可我真不确定有什么是你们还不知道、而我能教的。

lines.en: : It’s fine if we {i}know{/i} something already. We’re just here to evaluate your teaching ability. In fact, it’s probably {i}better{/i} if you “teach” us something we already know so we can hear how you explain it.
lines.zh: : 我们{i}已经知道{/i}什么也没关系。我们只是来评估你的教学能力。事实上，如果你「教」我们一些本来就懂的东西，可能{i}更好{/i}，这样我们能听听你怎么讲解。

lines.en: : How about literature? You looked up to Senpai before I got here, right? That was {i}his{/i} field of expertise. And I know you read a lot too.
lines.zh: : 文学怎么样？在我来之前你很崇拜 Senpai，对吧？那是{i}他{/i}的专长领域。而且我知道你也读很多书。

lines.en: : Well, yes...but the books I’ve been reading lately aren’t exactly fit for school. And I’m even {i}worse{/i} at writing, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯，是的……不过我最近看的书都不太适合学校。而且我写作{i}更差{/i}，所以……

lines.en: : Chin up. And fake confidence if you can’t find it. Once a teacher shows weakness, their students will jump {i}all{/i} over it.
lines.zh: : 振作点。找不到自信就装出来。老师一旦露出软弱，学生就会{i}一拥而上{/i}。

lines.en: : I guess that explains Arakawa’s {i}popularity{/i} too.
lines.zh: : 我想这也能解释 Arakawa 的{i}受欢迎程度{/i}。

lines.en: scene teacherwar18
: Do you choose violence the moment you get out of bed or is it my face that spurs you to action?
lines.zh: : 你是起床的瞬间就选择暴力，还是我的脸激发了你动手？

lines.en: : It comes naturally. It’s not really a conscious thing.
lines.zh: : 是自然流露。真不是有意识的。

lines.en: : Arakawa-kun, please pay attention in class. I’ve been standing here for almost a minute now and you’ve yet to even look at me.
lines.zh: : Arakawa 同学，上课请专心。我都在这儿站了快一分钟了，你还没正眼看过我。

lines.en: scene teacherwar19
: Oh, sorry. I’m just not really used to being on this end of the educational process.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。我只是不太习惯处在教育过程的这一端。

lines.en: : I’m not used to being on any end of it. I just turn on the metronome for Sana once a day and collect a paycheck. I’m one of those “essential worker” things I think.
lines.zh: : 我哪一端的都不习惯。我每天就给 Sana 开一次节拍器，然后领工资。我想我也算那种「必要工作者」吧。

lines.en: : Very close, Rokuhara-san. You see, {i}teachers{/i} are considered essential workers. But society would not collapse if you forgot to turn on a metronome. There are plenty of people to fill that role.
lines.zh: : 很接近了，Rokuhara 女士。你看，{i}教师{/i}才被视为必要工作者。可就算你忘了开节拍器，社会也不会崩溃。能顶这个缺的人多的是。

lines.en: scene teacherwar20

: {size=-2}Take Arakawa-kun for example. If you ignore the fact that he’s still collecting a paycheck from the school during his {i}impossibly{/i} long sabbatical, he appears more or less the same as any other unemployed man out there.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}就拿 Arakawa 同学来说吧。如果不去管他在那段{i}漫长得不可思议{/i}的休假期间还领着学校的工资，他看上去跟外面任何一个失业男人没什么两样。{/size}

lines.en: : Surely {i}he{/i} could turn on a metronome. It requires no skill at all. But instead, he refuses to provide any relief whatsoever to the city’s labor shortage by remaining in his bed and staring at the ceiling all day.
lines.zh: : {i}他{/i}总该会开节拍器吧。那根本不需要任何技巧。可他偏偏整天赖在床上盯着天花板，不肯为这座城市的劳动力短缺提供哪怕一丝缓解。

lines.en: : I just want to make sure it isn’t going anywhere.
lines.zh: : 我只是想确认它不会跑掉。

lines.en: : Arakawa-kun, did you know that over 1%% of the population of Japan is estimated to be hikikomori — or those who self-isolate for extended periods of time to avoid all social contact in fear of shame or failure?
lines.zh: : Arakawa 同学，你知道吗？据估计日本有超过 1%% 的人口是「家里蹲」——也就是因为害怕羞耻或失败而长期自我隔离、回避一切社交的人。

lines.en: : I can’t tell if I’m learning things or just getting called out here.
lines.zh: : 我分不清自己是在学东西，还是单纯在被人点名批评。

lines.en: scene teacherwar21
: Who says it can’t be both? One of the most tried and true ways to learn {i}anything{/i} is through personal experience.
lines.zh: : 谁说不能两者兼有？学习{i}任何东西{/i}最可靠的方法之一，就是通过亲身经历。

lines.en: : And just because you’re a failure now doesn’t mean you {i}have{/i} to be so long as you try to overcome it and get better. You don’t want to be some sort of statistic, do you, Arakawa-kun?
lines.zh: : 而且就算你现在是个失败者，只要你努力克服、变得更好，也不代表你{i}必须{/i}一直是。你不想只是成为某种统计数据吧，Arakawa 同学？

lines.en: : Not really. But I also don’t want to do anything either. And I am perfectly capable of feeling ashamed from the comfort of my own home.
lines.zh: : 确实不想。可我也不想做任何事。而且我完全可以在自己家里舒舒服服地感到羞耻。

lines.en: : Right you are. And it is that mindset that leads to situations like Rokuhara-san pressing a button and then deeming herself essential.
lines.zh: : 说得很对。而正是这种心态，才造就了像 Rokuhara 女士按一下按钮就自认不可或缺的局面。

lines.en: : Those with talent should {i}use{/i} it. And I know you’re capable. So the fact that you’re {i}not{/i} using it makes me think you just need someone to believe in you. Like me, for example.
lines.zh: : 有才能的人应该{i}去用{/i}它。而我知道你有这个能力。所以你{i}没有{/i}去用它，让我觉得你只是需要有人相信你。比如我。

lines.en: : Can I have a compliment now? Akira’s getting to hear all this nice stuff and all I’m hearing is that my job is going to be replaced by AI.
lines.zh: : 现在能夸夸我了吗？Akira 听的全是好话，而我听到的全是我的工作要被 AI 取代了。

lines.en: : With all due respect, your job should probably just not even exist.
lines.zh: : 恕我直言，你那份工作大概本来就不该存在。

lines.en: scene black
scene teacherwar22
Seeing the two of them like this...and hearing from Touka that I’m wasting my talent makes me kind of miss being a teacher for the moment.
lines.zh: 看着她们俩这样……又听 Touka 说我在浪费自己的才华，让我一时有点怀念当老师的日子。

lines.en: I know I left because I figured it’s what was best for everyone, but...maybe in another world, I stuck around and toughed it out.
lines.zh: 我知道我离开是因为觉得那对大家都好，不过……也许在另一个世界里，我留了下来，咬牙撑过来了。

lines.en: I mean, it’s not like all of my alone time has made me any better of a person. And, in a lot of ways, I might actually be worse because it really {i}is{/i} like I’m just not contributing at all anymore.
lines.zh: 我是说，我独处的那些时间也没让我变成更好的人。而且在很多方面，我可能反而更糟了——因为{i}确实{/i}就像我一点贡献都没有了。

lines.en: I think if I ever did come back, I’d try a little harder. I wouldn’t just confine myself to the space behind a desk while waiting for the bell to ring each day.
lines.zh: 我想如果有一天我真的回来，我会更努力一点。我不会只是把自己困在讲台后面，每天等着铃响。

lines.en: And, if I ever did, I’d have Imani to back me up. Wakana too. Even Rika who, despite not being a teacher, is still a great friend. There are so many people in this building that support me and want me to succeed.
lines.zh: 而且，如果我真的回来，我会有 Imani 支持我。Wakana 也是。连 Rika 也是——尽管她不是老师，依然是个很棒的朋友。这栋楼里有那么多人支持我、希望我成功。

lines.en: Yet my inaction and failure to do anything with that knowledge is but one more testament to my affinity for solitary confinement. How I’m at ease when things are easy. How hard it is to leave the room.
lines.zh: 可我明知道这些却无所作为，这不过又一次印证了我对自我封闭的偏爱。事情轻松时我有多安逸，走出这个房间就有多难。

lines.en: And how things like that are just as true for girls like Futaba. But there she is, smiling and doing her best because she {i}wants{/i} to be better and {i}doesn’t{/i} want to be like me.
lines.zh: 而像 Futaba 这样的女生何尝不是如此。可她就在那儿，微笑着全力以赴，因为她{i}想{/i}变得更好，{i}不想{/i}变成我这样。

lines.en: I won’t take credit for this. I imagine this is all Imani’s doing. Or something that falls from the hands that try to hold her up.
lines.zh: 这我不会揽功。我想这都是 Imani 的功劳。或者是从那些试图托住她的手中滑落的东西。

lines.en: But whatever it is, I’m envious. Of the joy. How her hands {i}should{/i} be shaking but {i}aren’t.{/i} Meanwhile, mine are tucked beneath the desk so no one can see them.
lines.zh: 可不管那是什么，我都嫉妒。嫉妒那份喜悦。她的手{i}本该{/i}在发抖，却{i}没有{/i}。而我的手藏在桌子底下，好让谁也看不见。

lines.en: She spends the class explaining the differences in fantasy subgenres to Imani and Wakana, who do a great job of feigning interest. Or maybe they just {i}are{/i} interested? I don’t know. I can’t see inside of their minds.
lines.zh: 她整节课都在跟 Imani 和 Wakana 讲解奇幻小说的各种子类型，而她们装出感兴趣的样子装得很好。又或者她们{i}真的{/i}感兴趣？我不知道。我看不进她们的心里。

lines.en: But if I could, I’d look around in hopes that they cherish this moment. That they see how big it is and how far she’s come from the quiet girl in the library I met so many years ago.
lines.zh: 但如果我能，我会四处看看，希望她们珍惜这一刻。希望她们看到这有多重大，看到她比起多年前我在图书馆遇见的那个安静女孩已经走了多远。

lines.en: scene black
scene teacherwar23

{size=-4}Touka’s strategy stays more or less the same with pointing out my and Rika’s flaws, but there’s much more emphasis put on facts and how to turn them around than there is beating around the bush or sugarcoating our inadequacies.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-4}Touka 的策略大体没变，还是在指出我和 Rika 的缺点，只是相比拐弯抹角或粉饰我们的不足，她更侧重于摆事实、以及怎么把事实反过来用。{/size}

lines.en: I can’t tell if she lucked out with students like us or if this works against her in some way. Nor can I tell if what she’s doing is actually inspirational or not.
lines.zh: 我分不清她是碰巧遇到我们这样的学生，还是这套做法在某种程度上对她不利。我也分不清她在做的事到底算不算鼓舞人心。

lines.en: But it got me thinking. {i}Seriously{/i} thinking. And that’s more than most things do lately.
lines.zh: 但它让我开始思考。{i}认真{/i}地思考。而这已经比最近大多数事情能做到的更多了。

lines.en: So perhaps her goal wasn’t to be a motivator so much as it was to cause some self-reflection.
lines.zh: 所以也许她的目标与其说是当个激励者，不如说是引发一些自我反省。

lines.en: Because yeah, some people {i}are{/i} just talented. And watching them waste all that away won’t ever feel good if you really do believe in them.
lines.zh: 因为是啊，有些人{i}确实{/i}就是有才华。而如果你真的相信他们，看着他们把才华全部浪费掉，永远不会好受。

lines.en: It makes me wonder if this comes from a place of personal experience or just the desire {i}to{/i} experience such things. Because I still don’t know if my approach with her was {i}right{/i} or not.
lines.zh: 这让我想知道，这到底是出于亲身经历，还是仅仅出于{i}想要{/i}经历这些事的渴望。因为我到现在都不知道，我对她的那种做法到底是{i}对{/i}还是错。

lines.en: She hated me at first...but look at us now. Look at the holes I’ve carved in her heart and how {i}love{/i} oozes from each and every septal defect until the two of us are bathed in it.
lines.zh: 她一开始恨我……可看看我们现在的样子。看看我在她心上凿出的那些洞，看看{i}爱{/i}是怎样从每一处缺损里渗出来，直到我们俩都被它浸透。

lines.en: Is that {i}enough,{/i} though? Enough to make me {i}move.{/i} Or would she rather I just stay?
lines.zh: 可那{i}够吗{/i}？够让我{i}动起来{/i}吗？还是说她更希望我就这样待着？

lines.en: I feel like she’d answer if I asked her.
lines.zh: 我觉得如果我问她，她会回答的。

lines.en: scene black
But, as always...
lines.zh: 但是，一如既往……

lines.en: I can not find the strength.
lines.zh: 我找不到那份力气。

lines.en: scene teacherwar24
: Alright, gang. That’s a full hour worth of learning and I am pleased to say that, despite several early distractions, this contest was definitely {i}not{/i} a trainwreck.
lines.zh: : 好了，各位。整整一小时的学习结束了，我很高兴地说，尽管开头有若干干扰，这场比赛绝对{i}不算{/i}一场灾难。

lines.en: : I imagine that just means the obstacle course will be, though. So RIP Wakana, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不过我想这意味着障碍赛道会是场灾难。所以 Wakana，安息吧，我猜。

lines.en: : But anyway, how’d you guys feel about teaching? Any new career plans going forward? Has this one day changed the entire trajectory of your lives?
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，你们教书的感觉怎么样？以后有什么新的职业规划吗？这一天改变了你们人生的整个轨迹了吗？

lines.en: : Not in the slightest. I did enjoy being able to constructively criticize Sensei in a controlled environment, though. It was like being able to throw tomatoes at him while he’s locked behind bars. Quite nice, really.
lines.zh: : 一点也没有。不过我确实很享受能在一个可控的环境里对 Sensei 进行建设性批评。那感觉就像他被关在栏杆后面，而我可以朝他扔西红柿。真的挺不错。

lines.en: : I...didn’t exactly have the same experience. I did have fun, though.
lines.zh: : 我……的体验不太一样。不过我玩得挺开心。

lines.en: : I don’t know if this will, like...change anything about my future, but...I don’t know. I don’t really have anything I specifically want to do yet anyway, so...
lines.zh: : 我不知道这会不会……改变我的未来什么的，不过……我不知道。反正我现在也没有什么特别想做的事，所以……

lines.en: : We’ll see...
lines.zh: : 走着瞧吧……

lines.en: scene teacherwar25
: Well, the original plan here was for me to be the judge of this contest...but seeing as Senpai was equally as involved, perhaps he and I should collaborate?
lines.zh: : 嗯，原本的计划是由我来当这场比赛的评委……不过既然 Senpai 的参与度同样很高，也许我和他该合作一下？

lines.en: : You’re just torn because you like both of them and need me to break the tie, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你只是因为两个都喜欢、下不了决心，需要我来打破僵局，对吧？

lines.en: : Kinda, yeah.
lines.zh: : 算是吧，对。

lines.en: I had a feeling things would come to this. But I’d already made up my mind before I was even asked...
lines.zh: 我就知道事情会走到这一步。不过在被问到之前，我心里已经做了决定……

lines.en: And my choice for who the best teacher out of these two would be is...
lines.zh: 而在这两人之中，我选出的最佳教师是……

lines.en: menu:
Futaba
lines.zh: Futaba

lines.en: : In that case, I have to give it to Futaba.
lines.zh: : 那样的话，我必须把这一票投给 Futaba。

lines.en: scene teacherwar26
: R-Really?! I...actually beat Touka? She’s...so much smarter than me, though.
lines.zh: : 真……真的吗？！我……真的赢了 Touka？可她……比我聪明太多了。

lines.en: : Touka wasn’t bad by any means. I just don’t think the style she employed today would jive with most people — especially ones your age.
lines.zh: : Touka 绝不差。我只是觉得她今天用的那套风格不会跟大多数人合拍——尤其是你们这个年纪的人。

lines.en: : Futaba, you have a lot to learn still, but your more traditional methods and soft demeanor would make you a great teacher for younger kids.
lines.zh: : Futaba，你还有很多要学的，但你更传统的方法和温和的举止，会让你成为教小孩子的好老师。

lines.en: : Your presence is comforting and calming and your passion was clearly evident even if you spent most of your time with Imani and Wakana.
lines.zh: : 你的存在令人安心、平静，而你的热情也显而易见，尽管你大部分时间都跟 Imani 和 Wakana 在一起。

lines.en: : Th...Thank you, Sensei! That really means a lot to me. And...congratulations to you too, Touka. Even if you didn’t win.
lines.zh: : 谢……谢谢你，Sensei！这对我意义重大。还有……也祝贺你，Touka。尽管你没赢。

lines.en: scene teacherwar27
: I could have sworn you had me beat when I started hearing you throw out a bunch of numbers and stuff...hahah...
lines.zh: : 我开始听到你甩出一堆数字什么的，还以为你稳赢我了……哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Oh, yes. Congratulations to you, Futaba. You were quite exceptional yourself.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。恭喜你，Futaba。你自己也相当出色。

lines.en: : Nothing else to add from the losing side?
lines.zh: : 输的这一方没什么要补充的吗？

lines.en: : No. I’ve said my piece already. And even if I did not win, I think the weight of my words today will still make an impact.
lines.zh: : 没有。我想说的已经说完了。就算我没赢，我想我今天那些话的分量依然会产生影响。

lines.en: scene black
: And if the point of teaching is to touch lives or bring out the best in someone, then...
lines.zh: : 而如果教育的意义在于触动生命、或激发一个人最好的一面，那么……

lines.en: : I suppose we’ll just have to wait and see if I make any difference at all.
lines.zh: : 我想我们只能等着看我到底有没有带来任何改变。

lines.en: $ dormwarssixfloor1points += 1
$ futabateacherwin = True
Touka
lines.zh: Touka

lines.en: : In that case, I have to give it to Touka.
lines.zh: : 那样的话，我必须把这一票投给 Touka。

lines.en: scene teacherwar28
: Though, I {i}will{/i} say I don’t think her strategy would be best for everyone. And that pointing out the flaws in people can do more harm than good if they aren’t ready to hear them.
lines.zh: : 不过，我{i}得{/i}说，我认为她的策略并非对每个人都最好。而且指出别人的缺点，如果对方还没准备好听，可能弊大于利。

lines.en: : Perhaps you should take your own advice then, Sensei. You weren’t all that {i}reserved{/i} with me when I first arrived either, were you?
lines.zh: : 那 Sensei 你自己也该听听这建议。我刚来的时候，你对我可一点都不{i}客气{/i}，对吧？

lines.en: : No, I most certainly was not. But I think you turned out okay. Which means the two of us might be a little more similar than you thought.
lines.zh: : 不，我确实一点都不客气。可我觉得你现在结果还不错。这意味着我们俩也许比你以为的更相似。

lines.en: : Oh, no. How {i}horrible{/i} that would be.
lines.zh: : 哦，不。那{i}多可怕{/i}啊。

lines.en: : Is it just me or is the vibe here getting kinda weird all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 是我一个人的感觉，还是这儿的气氛突然变得有点诡异了？

lines.en: : Congratulations, Touka. I kind of knew you’d win, but it was still fun regardless.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，Touka。我大概知道你会赢，不过还是很好玩。

lines.en: scene teacherwar29
: It was, wasn’t it? And might I say, Futaba, I had no idea there were so many types of fantasy novels. So while you may not have won, you certainly taught {i}me{/i} something.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不是吗？容我说一句，Futaba，我完全不知道奇幻小说有这么多类型。所以虽然你没赢，你确实教会了{i}我{/i}一些东西。

lines.en: : Really? That’s great. I’d be...happy to give you some recommendations if you ever drop by the library.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？太好了。如果哪天你顺道去图书馆，我很……乐意给你推荐几本。

lines.en: : I’ll see if I can make the time. I’d love to share some recommendations of my own with you too, if that’s okay. I’m not particularly well-versed in fantasy, but-
lines.zh: : 我看看能不能腾出时间。我也很想跟你分享一些我自己推荐的作品，如果可以的话。我对奇幻不算特别精通，不过——

lines.en: : Sorry, Touka. Futaba only reads books with elf-sex in them.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Touka。Futaba 只看有精灵性爱场面的书。

lines.en: scene teacherwar30
: Oh. Well...I don’t think I know of any books like that.
lines.zh: : 哦。那个……我想我不太知道有哪类书是那样的。

lines.en: : S-Sensei! No I don’t! I read other books! In fact, {i}most{/i} of the books I read don’t have anything like that!
lines.zh: : S……Sensei！我才不是！我也看别的书！事实上，我看的书{i}大多数{/i}都没有那种内容！

lines.en: : She’s lying to you, Touka. It’s the only thing she’s interested in.
lines.zh: : 她在骗你，Touka。那是她唯一感兴趣的东西。

lines.en: : Man, if you just spoiled a potential friendship with your weird elf-sex thing, I’m gonna be pissed as Hell.
lines.zh: : 天哪，如果你因为你那套奇怪的精灵性爱把一段潜在的友谊搞黄了，我会气死的。

lines.en: scene black
: I have interests other than elf-sex!!!!
lines.zh: : 除了精灵性爱我还有别的兴趣！！！！

lines.en: : “Other” would imply that...it is {i}an{/i} interest, though...yes?
lines.zh: : 不过，「别的」是不是意味着……那{i}也算{/i}一种兴趣……对吧？

lines.en: : That...I...
: I...don’t want to say!
lines.zh: : 我……不想说！

lines.en: : She loves it. Just look at her.
lines.zh: : 她爱死了。看看她那副样子。

lines.en: : Aaaaaaaahhhhhhhhhh!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！

lines.en: $ dormwarssixfloor2points += 1
$ toukateacherwin = True
: Okay, okay! That’s seven contests down and three to go!
lines.zh: : 好了好了！七场比赛结束，还剩三场！

lines.en: : We’ve got {i}one{/i} more at the school before we head over to Koi Cafe for the barista war, so if everyone could now make their way over to the gym for the obstacle course, it would be-
lines.zh: : 在去 Koi Cafe 打咖啡师大战之前，我们在学校还有{i}最后一场{/i}，那么请各位现在移步体育馆参加障碍赛道，那就——

jump dormwarssix9
